name: ec-tax-overview
description: Tax overview for Ecuador, tax year 2026: the main taxes and their headline figures in one place, each tied to the law or the SRI, with the skill that holds the full rules. Covers the calendar tax year, the US dollar, the Servicio de Rentas Internas, the worldwide basis for residents, personal income tax from 0% to 37% with the USD 12,208 exempt band, the 25% company rate, the 12% dividend single tax (10% to non-residents), IVA at 15%, IESS contributions of 9.45% and 11.15% on pay, the USD 482 salario básico unificado, withholding of 25% or 37% on payments abroad, the 5% currency outflow tax (ISD), and the March and April return windows by ninth digit of the RUC. Trigger phrases: Ecuador tax overview, how is Ecuador taxed, Ecuador tax rates 2026, impuestos Ecuador 2026, SRI. Detail lives in the sibling skills: ecuador-income-tax, ec-corporate-income-tax, ecuador-iva, ecuador-payroll, ecuador-social-contributions, ec-cross-border, ec-transfer-pricing, ec-company-formation.
